comment: The three params carry the colour internally but have no widget on the panel, so no knob can be clicked. A note from an earlier pass said the ColorMode menu was dead; that is wrong for the installed 2.0.1, where ColorPanelFrame::step() reads colorMode and picks nvgRGBf or nvgHSL accordingly. The maker's own param names, 'Red or Hue', 'Green or Saturation' and 'Blue or Lightness', say the same thing.
